title: Customer-facing content is Resource Editor/contract authority, not interface copy
summary: Wire UI carries exact published resource identity. Wire UI Resource Editor/Resource Contract own immutable publication and bytes; Builder places semantics/resource references; runtime resolvers verify/select only approved representations; renderers do not invent copy or URLs.
invariants: Builder is not a content editor; customer-facing descriptions/copy/images are published resources.
Resource Editor/contract own immutable resource identity, bytes and publication receipts; current evidence uses SHA-512 publication.
Wire definitions carry exact ResourceRef identity/provenance and semantic role, never content URLs/paths/inline bytes.
Runtime resolvers consume exact published refs and may select only an approved representation of that same exact resource.
Renderer presentation may style approved material but must not synthesize substitute headlines, labels, terms, marketing copy or resource URLs.
Backend eligibility/assessment determines whether an offer is appropriate; renderer does not infer eligibility.

provenance.claim: Builder semantic authoring remains separate from content authority.
